dedupe_keys.name: grid frequency measurements of the nordic power system during 2018

description: Grid Frequency Measurements of the Nordic Power System during 2018. is a data set deposited in DTU Data by its authors Andreas Thingvad, Mattia Marinelli. The grid frequency is measured in Zealand, Denmark (DK-2), as a part of the Nordic power system (ENTSOE RG-N). 336.4 days are measured with the DEIF MTR-311.7 days are measured with the Schneider PM80016,9 days are not measured. Coverage: continental (DK); the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The repository holds 2 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 150799554 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
